spirits.name: Nuclear electricity

spirits.name: Force de frappe

spirits.name: The 35-hour week

spirits.name: Pension reform
spirits.description: A later retirement age keeps the pension system solvent.

spirits.name: Operations in the Sahel
spirits.description: French troops fight Islamist groups in the Sahel.

spirits.name: Reindustrialisation
spirits.description: Investment in new factories, nuclear reactors and green industry.
